 Order
Order No. 21.04.2023
01.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with C.T. (Sessions) Case No.15 of 2023 arising out of Banaharpali P.S. Case No.272 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Jharsuguda for offences punishable under sections 376(2)(n)/417/294/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Jharsuguda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Jharsuguda // 2 // vide order dated 16.03.2023.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 05.12.2022 and charge sheet has been submitted under sections 376(2)(n)/417/ 294/506 of the Indian Penal Code and after going through the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, who is aged about nineteen years stated about her love affairs and physical relationship with the petitioner and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, who placed the medical examination report of the victim, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.

entities.text: Hemsagar Bhainsa vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper.
Accordingly, the BLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge RKM Hemsagar Bhainsa vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
